notes.title: Steam Next Fest | Developer plays Sentient Noir DEMO
notes.notes:
[b]Last day of the Fest Event - come check out our game DEMO LIVE[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38765149/2c74164170c0581588782d2197ad74d2549c4769.jpg[/img]

Sentient Noir, is a video game currently in development. Our target platforms are PS4/PS5, [b]Steam[/b] and Switch. It's set in a dystopian alien City called [b]Night Light City[/b] where four factions want the incredible powers of a Detective Hunter for their own ends. With these powers, you're able to manipulate, befriend, betray, instill fear and destroy the sentient populous. You are feared, but maybe that can change as you discover the true nature of the sentient city.

notes.title: Sentient Noir DEMO V2 play-through!
notes.notes:
[b]Come and see us play Sentient Noir Demo[/b]

[previewyoutube=ll6FTEPwlA0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

We play our game and show you some of the features that will be in the the full version. Here's your chance to ask some questions, have fun and maybe influence our game to better cater for you.

If you like what you are seeing, why not give us a follow? Add us to your wish-list and spread the word about our game.

notes.title: Sentient Noir DEMO V2 - UPGRADE!
notes.notes:
[b] DEMO UPDATE V2[/b]

Hi guys, we're happy to announce that  [b] version 2[/b] of our demo has been released for you to play. This build has a lot of improvements we think you guys would love. So here's what we've got so for:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38765149/d507f68f7dda22f7baa2edb03ada0800842397b5.png[/img]

[list]
[*] New lighting and particle FX for characters and environments
[list]
[*] New idle and intro animations for prologue
[/list]
[list]
[*] polish to combo attacks for Huru
[/list]
[list]
[*] Huru now can take up to 4 hits during her base state
[/list]
[list]
[*] new soundtrack added to Winter street
[/list]
[list]
[*] Gun shop! You can purchase guns at the store if you're adventurous enough!
[/list]
[list]
[*] Huru now has gunslinger mechanics!
[/list]
[list]
[*] You can now access the alleyway and the Spot Plaza areas
[/list]
[list]
[*] More tutorials have been added
[/list]
[list]
[*] Overall optimization
[/list]
[/list]

I'm sure there's more we've left out but this list should hold some weight as to why to upgrade your demo. We genuinely hope you have a great time with the game as we think we're finally seeing the fun-factor in this project.

Again, any questions, constructive feedback would be appreciated. And if you like what we're making, then please go ahead and share your enthusiasm with your friends and families.

For the players.
